entity.name: Rohith Singh
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of Linea, an open-source runtime and control plane for production AI agents.

projects.name: Linea
projects.description: Linea is an open-source (Apache-2.0) runtime and control plane for production AI agents. Workflows run as versioned graphs on durable Postgres and BullMQ workers with checkpoints, crash recovery, human approvals, consent-gated external actions, step replay, and regression tests built from saved executions. It ships a public versioned /v1 protocol with server, browser, native and React SDKs, so teams can run governed, auditable agents on infrastructure they own instead of proprietary platforms.
